correctness.rationale: Fourier Parseval turns moments into weighted equal base-b signed-digit sums. Integer carries obey b u_{j+1}=u_j+k_j-l_j with zero endpoints. For r<b no nonzero carry can arise, so sum binomial(r,k)^2=binomial(2r,r) factors. At r=b, reachable integer carries restricted to {-1,0,1}; exact T rows [[a,K,0],[1,C,1],[0,K,a]] by Vandermonde, with central-state symmetric 2x2 characteristic (λ-C)(λ-a)-2K. Cayley-Hamilton yields the recurrence for all b,n; λ-=positive because a C>2K, λ-<C<λ+, both spectral coefficients positive, and explicit 2-step nonzero carry loops give E(n)>C^n for n≥2. Independent direct convolution b=2..6, n≤3 and source checker code verified critical figures.

final_claim: For every integer b≥2, n≥1 and 1≤r<b, normalized Haar 2r moments of ∏_{j<n}(1+z^{b^j}) equal binom(2r,r)^n. At critical r=b the moments satisfy an exact two-eigenvalue recurrence with C=binom(2b,b), K=binom(2b,b-1), a=2b: E_{n+2}=(C+a)E_{n+1}-(aC-2K)E_n; growth λ+>C.
limitations: All integer b≥2 and n≥1 for r≤b only; Haar measure and coefficients 1; not Cantor-measure moments or arbitrary Fourier taps.
